title: Fifth Era Acquisition Corp I 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: Fifth Era Acquisition Corp I (FERA), a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq, entered into a Business Combination Agreement dated April 7, 2026 to merge with SMT Holdings Limited, an Abu Dhabi-based strategic metals platform. The combined entity will be held by Miotal SPAC HoldCo, Inc. The deal values the target company's metals inventory at approximately $35 billion, comprising ultrafine copper powder, ultrafine nickel wire, and rare earth metals. FERA expects closing in H1 2026 pending shareholder and regulatory approvals.
key_points: FERA is a Nasdaq-listed SPAC (tickers: FERAU, FERA, FERAR) incorporated in the Cayman Islands with Commission File Number 001-42539
Business Combination Agreement signed April 7, 2026 involves FERA, Miotal SPAC HoldCo, Merger Sub, and SMT Holdings Limited
SMT Holdings is a strategic metals platform holding inventory of ultrafine copper powder (6N purity), ultrafine nickel wire, and rare earth metals
Company estimates total inventory value at approximately $35 billion based on prevailing market prices
Exchange ratio: FERA ordinary shares convert 1:1 to Holdco Ordinary Shares; Company Shares exchanged at $10 billion total value ($10.00/share)
Deal expected to close first half 2026 subject to shareholder approvals, regulatory requirements, and customary closing conditions
Holdco board will consist of 7 directors: CEO plus 1 Sponsor designee plus 5 Company designees
